articles.title: Kraken operator Payward and Singapore Gulf Bank partner for 24/7 institutional crypto settlement
articles.snippet: The two firms will initially roll out the digital assets settlement service to select institutional clients in Asia and the Gulf region with around-the-clock U.S. dollar settlement.

articles.title: Vivek Ramaswamy’s gubernatorial run lacks the crypto rhetoric of his presidential bid
articles.snippet: The Ohio Republican candidate holds a stake in a digital asset manager and received donations from many in the industry, but has avoided making crypto a central campaign issue.

articles.title: European crypto users have ‘more faith’ in regulated firms under MiCA: Bitpanda co-CEO
articles.snippet: Speaking on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction, Christian Trummer said MiCA has increased trust in regulated platforms and called for stricter enforcement against noncompliant firms.
